node.description: A 7-port USB hub offers the convenience of connecting and using several USB devices simultaneously from a single USB port, such as external hard drives, printers, keyboards, and more, without the need to constantly swap cables and ensure efficient multitasking and device management. Elevate your PC's connectivity with Anker's innovative 7 port USB hubs, designed to bring convenience and efficiency to your digital world. Our compact and portable USB hubs can transform your PC's capabilities by effortlessly adding 7 USB 3.0 SuperSpeed ports, boasting data transfer rates of up to 5Gbps for lightning-fast sync times. Whether you're transferring files or streaming media, the speed is unmatched. What truly sets these 7-port USB 3.0 hubs apart is the charging prowess. With one port delivering BC 1.2 charging speeds of up to 2.1 amps, and the remaining 6 ports providing up to 0.5A each, a total of 5.1 amps can be distributed seamlessly across all 7 ports. This means you can simultaneously charge your devices efficiently, making it an ideal hub for a multitude of tasks. Meanwhile, steady operation is guaranteed through a high-grade chipset and a 36-watt adapter, ensuring reliability in every use. Moreover, our USB hubs are plug-and-play. Combined with hot-swapping, you're hassle-free in using them with various devices with different operating systems by effortless integrations. No driver installations are needed for nearly all mainstream Windows or Mac systems, ensuring a consistent and streamlined user experience.
